New York, NY – October 30, 2026 – AMC Global Media’s popular streamer All Reality, the premier destination for bold reality TV and true crime, today released the official key art and sneak peek of Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie, the new paranormal investigation series starring reality television icon Nicole “Snooki” Polizzi (Jersey Shore). The eight-episode series premieres in the U.S. on Friday, November 13, exclusively on All Reality, with new episodes streaming every Friday. 

Blending humor, curiosity and unexpected discoveries, the Crave original series Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie showcases a new side of Snooki, as she steps into the world of paranormal investigation and explores some of North America’s most haunted locations. Alongside Kevin Whitaker, one of North America’s foremost psychic mediums, occult expert and historian Missy Morrow and tech specialist Todd Thomas; Snooki embarks on an eye-opening journey from paranormal novice to investigator, confronting chilling mysteries and unexplained phenomena along the way. 

A Crave original series, Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie is produced by Buck Productions in association with My Entertainment and Bell Media’s Crave. Executive producers are Sean Buckley, Jim Kiriakakis, Nicole “Snooki” Polizzi and Justin Stockman. Kyle Whitelaw serves as showrunner and director. 

Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie is distributed internationally by Sphere Abacus, a Bell Media company. 

Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie is the newest addition to All Reality’s deep library of intriguing reality and true crime, joining popular series such as The Braxtons, the Love After Lockup franchise, Bridezillas, Archive X and more. 

For additional series information, follow All Reality on Facebook, Instagram, X and TikTok.
